programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Penipu cantik bernama Hua mencuri sebuah cincin berlian dari toko di Hong Kong dan kabur ke Singapura. Untuk menghindari bea cukai, ia memasukkan cincin itu ke dalam saku pria asing, tapi ia kehilangan jejaknya.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: Dalam film yang merangkai misteri dan ketegangan dengan aksi kung fu ini, seorang ahli kung fu membalas dendam setelah mendekam selama 15 tahun di penjara. Ia mampu bertahan menghadapi ujian di sepanjang hidupnya!

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: Dalam tradisi Opera Huangmei, film ini menceritakan kisah cinta Wen, yang menjual dirinya sebagai budak ke sebuah keluarga kaya, dan Huo, seorang putri muda dari keluarga itu.

programme.title: The Bells Of Death
programme.desc: Berkisah tentang perjalanan hidup seorang pria untuk belajar pedang, lalu melaksanakan balas dendamnya pada 3 pria yang telah membunuh keluarganya dan menculik adiknya.

programme.title: Sword Stained With Royal Blood
programme.desc: Diangkat dari novel karya Jin Yong, kekacauan terjadi ketika seorang prajurit yang tengah melarikan diri menemukan sebuah pedang, kitab sakti, peta harta karun dan sebuah pesan rahasia di atas jasad seorang guru.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Fu membunuh kepala klan Wu Dang dan menjebak Yun sebagai pembunuhnya. Fu lalu menyatakan dirinya sebagai kepala klan baru dan memerintahkan untuk membunuh Yun, yang bersumpah untuk membalas kematian ayahnya.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: Big Potato membuka sebuah klinik Tiongkok kuno, namun metode tradisionalnya ditolak oleh masyarakat Hong Kong modern yang skeptis. Ia meminta sahabatnya, Mr. Funnybone, untuk membantu menyelamatkan kliniknya.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: Ratu Kung-Fu asal Hong Kong, Cheng Pei-pei, berperan sebagai pendekar pedang wanita yang melakukan misi untuk membalas dendam atas kematian orangtuanya dan menyelamatkan negara dari penjajah asing.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai memerankan tokoh Pak Su-cheng, dewi ular nan mempesona yang memilih wujud sebagai seorang wanita sehingga ia dapat merasakan indahnya kehidupan manusia!

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: Qiao Miao hampir membunuh bandit yang baru saja ia temui, tapi ia tertarik dengan kecantikannya dan dengan cepat keduanya jatuh cinta. Kemudian, mereka terlibat dalam perseteruan antara pemilik senjata nan unik.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Perancang busana Shi tidak terima dengan kritik Mui kala memintanya untuk mengomentari desain barunya. Saat Mui memintanya untuk merancang gaun untuk menghadiri pesta, Shi membalas dendam dengan membuat kostum badut.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li meminta Wang, rekannya yang terpercaya untuk melindungi keluarganya saat ia pergi. Namun Wang memperkosa istrinya, membunuh pelayannya dan menyerang rombongan Li. Li khawatir jika putrinya masih berada dalam bahaya!

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: Dalam drama yang mengerikan ini, aktris populer Shaw Brothers, Li Jing, berperan sebagai putri pemilik penginapan di daerah pegunungan. Ia menyaksikan aksi pemerkosaan yang dilakukan oleh salah seorang penduduk.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: Seorang putri bangsawan diculik oleh bandit Golden Dragon Hill yang terkenal kejam. Seorang pendekar pedang bernama Yue Zhen Bei ditugaskan untuk menyelamatkannya, dan ia menghadapi banyak bahaya dalam perjalanannya.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai memerkosa Qiu Rong dan berjanji akan menikahinya usai mendapat persetujuan orang tuanya. Namun, tak ada kabar lagi tentang pernikahan tersebut. Qiu pun mendesak Liang Cai saat menyadari bahwa dirinya hamil.

programme.title: Call To Arms
programme.desc: Kekaisaran Chin yang agresif dan berbahaya menaklukkan kerajaan Chao yang tangguh, sementara kekaisaran Wei kehabisan pahlawan-pahlawannya dan lumpuh dipimpin penguasa yang tidak tegas.

programme.title: Asia-Pol
programme.desc: Agen Asiapol Yang Ming Xuan melacak suatu paket emas ilegal yang dikirim untuk ketua geng bernama George Eaton. Ia juga meminta bantuan seorang wanita Tiongkok yang ingin membalaskan dendam saudarinya.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar berbakat, Bo Hu, tertarik dengan seorang pelayan nan cantik, Qiu Xiang. Agar dapat mendekatinya dan memenangkan cintanya, ia menyamar sebagai seorang pelayan untuk bekerja di rumah yang sama.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Dalam drama peraih berbagai penghargaan arahan Li Han Hsiang ini, Betty Loh Ti berperan sebagai gadis cantik yang menyamar sebagai anak lelaki demi mendapatkan pendidikan yang terlarang bagi anak perempuan.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: Sebuah kartel narkoba menduduki wilayah Dong Zhou. Mei Jing dari Unit Komando Wanita Thunderbolt memimpin timnya untuk menyerang markas mereka. Namun, Mei dan timnya disergap dan identitas ayah Mei terungkap.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: Klan Black Feather nan jahat menyusup ke wilayah Master Fire Cloud dan mencuri Topeng Shura, sehingga melepaskan roh jahat nan masih bayi. Namun, Master Fire Cloud mengadopsi bayi itu untuk mencegahnya menjadi jahat.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: Seorang pengusaha serakah dari Hong Kong menyewa seorang pemburu muda untuk menangkap gorila raksasa yang konon hidup jauh di dalam hutan India. Pemburu itu menemukan kera tersebut, dan hidup bersamanya ia menemukan seorang wanita liar yang telah berteman dengan makhluk itu.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Di sebuah pusat perbelanjaan di Hong Kong, intuisi Buck Yuen (Jackie Chan) memperingatkannya. Ia menyelamatkan hasil rampasan perampokan dan muncul di televisi, akhirnya sampai di Istanbul melalui Korea Selatan, dan tanpa sengaja menjadi mata-mata. Untungnya, ia menguasai Kung Fu.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: Selama lima tahun, Takumi yang berusia 18 tahun mengirimkan tahu setiap pagi dengan mengendarai Toyota AE86 kuno milik ayahnya. Ia pun mengembangkan teknik balap yang sempurna dan menjadi pembalap hebat.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Valentino adalah penipu ulung yang bertemu dengan Kwan, sesama penipu. Bersama-sama, mereka menyamar sebagai berbagai orang dan menciptakan berbagai skema untuk menghasilkan uang. Sementara itu, para gangster sedang menyusun skema mereka sendiri.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Bintang laga Chow Yun-Fat memerankan gangster sungguhan Chen Daqi saat ia naik ke eselon atas kekuasaan, mendapati dirinya terpecah antara cinta dua wanita, rencana pembunuhan dinas rahasia, dan ancaman perang yang membayangi.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Bintang laga Chow Yun-Fat memerankan gangster sungguhan Chen Daqi saat ia naik ke eselon atas kekuasaan, mendapati dirinya terpecah antara cinta dua wanita, rencana pembunuhan dinas rahasia, dan ancaman perang yang membayangi.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: Raja Kera bereinkarnasi dalam wujud bukan manusia sebagai Joker, seorang perampok jalanan yang tidak menyadari identitas aslinya dan fakta bahwa 500 tahun sebelumnya, dia dan tuannya, Biksu Panjang Umur, dihukum dan dipaksa untuk tetap menjadi manusia.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: Marbles, seorang anak berusia 10 tahun, menyaksikan pembunuhan seorang wanita muda.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: JJ/Shu Qi dan PI Lam mencuri dua plat USD100 yang dicuri di Hong Kong. Lam kehilangan mereka - tidak ada hadiah dari AS. Lam dan ketiga malaikat kecilnya mencoba mendapatkannya kembali di Seoul, begitu pula JJ. Banyak pertarungan.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Perampok kuburan menemukan vampir yang diawetkan. Saat mengangkut vampir anak, mantra yang mengikatnya hilang, dan ia berteman dengan penduduk setempat. Vampir orang tua terbangun dan melarikan diri. Tabib herbal mengejar untuk menghancurkan mereka.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh mengemban misi pertamanya sambil diam-diam menyelidiki penyebab pembantaian keluarganya beberapa tahun silam. Namun, ia malah terjerat dalam suatu konspirasi politik saat menjalankan misi.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: Sebelum memenangkan pujian dalam film laga berkat aksi-aksi mereka yang berani, para bintang ini menjalani tahun-tahun penuh darah, keringat, dan air mata saat berlatih di bawah bimbingan Master Yu yang kejam.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Berfokus pada migrasi Ip Man ke Hong Kong pada tahun 1949 saat ia berupaya menyebarkan disiplin ilmu bela diri Wing Chun yang dianutnya.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: Kaisar muda Kangxi sedang berusaha memilih seorang istri. Ibunya telah mengatur agar beberapa wanita muda yang tersedia mengunjunginya sehingga ia dapat memilih.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: Bercerita tentang seorang pria yang mendapat sepucuk surat gaib tentang prediksi kematiannya, pria lainnya tengah berduka atas kematian sang istri tercinta, serta tiga kakak beradik yang berselisih saat makan malam.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda tiba di kota untuk bekerja dengan teman mendiang sang ayah. Ketika toko pewarna mereka dibakar oleh seorang pemimpin geng setempat, ia memutuskan untuk melawan demi melindungi dan menyelamatkan toko.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Dokumenter ini menyoroti para master Kung Fu Tiongkok yang terkenal di industri film, memamerkan warisan Kung Fu Hong Kong selama enam puluh tahun dan mengabadikan kehidupan mereka yang penuh tantangan.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Nona Qiao meninggal secara tak wajar dan kepala pelayannya membayar seorang perajin untuk membuat sebuah boneka kertas. Serangkaian peristiwa nan mengerikan terjadi saat arwah Nona Qiao bangkit untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: The Hub With Wang Guan
programme.desc: Mencakup isu-isu geopolitik dan ekonomi yang sedang hangat, serta kisah-kisah menarik dan tren dalam budaya, pendidikan, teknologi dan gaya hidup. Majalah ini bertujuan untuk menghubungkan orang, budaya dan masyarakat di Timur dan Barat.

programme.title: Review
programme.desc: Review bursts into life with Matchweek 1 of the 2025/26 Premier League with a blockbuster Sunday showdown as Manchester United host Arsenal at Old Trafford. Chelsea face an immediate test against Crystal Palace, Wolves welcome Manchester City to Molinuex, and Liverpool kick-off their title defence against Bournemouth.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Ars) : Review Of The Season
programme.desc: As we wave goodbye to another action-packed and compelling Premier League campaign, Review of the Season takes you through the twists and turns of a gripping last 10 months. From how the title was won, the fight for European spots, and the battle to avoid relegation - all the key moments are covered from another scintillating season.

programme.title: The Great North London Divide : PL Stories
programme.desc: Set against one of the most dramatic seasons in recent memory, we explore the enduring intensity of the North London rivalry between Arsenal and Tottenham Hotspur. programme.title: Ketemu Di Mimpi Is Level 34 Of Kangen
programme.desc: Saskia (Saskia Chadwick) baru saja putus dengan pacarnya, lalu temannya menyarankan untuk ikut open trip wisata. Ia bertemu dengan Yudha (Rizki Nazar) yang mengaku sebagai leader open trip tersebut. Saskia dan Yudha pun bersama menatap bintang di tengah hutan pada malam hari. Saskia pun syok saat bangun di rumah sakit karena pingsan dan pihak travel tidak ada yang mengenal Yudha. Mungkinkah Yudha hanyalah imajinasi dari rasa trauma Saskia saja?

programme.title: Pov Disekop-Sekop Cogan 34M Followers
programme.desc: Saat lagi rusuh sama El (Cinta Brian), Echa (Zoe Abbas Jackson) nggak sengaja bikin Tristan (Kevin Hillers) celaka, sampai Tristan gak sadarkan diri. Saking paniknya Echa dan El mengira Tristan udah pindah alam. Echa stress dan mau lapor Polisi. Tapi El bilang, nggak akan ada yang percaya Tristan tewas karena kecelakaan. El lalu berniat membuang jenazah Tristan, supaya mereka nggak ditangkap Polisi. Echa terpaksa setuju. Saat hendak membuang jenazah, Tristan malah sadar dari pingsannya. Echa dan El shock melihat Tristan bangkit dari kematian. Echa dan El yang panik nyerocos menjelaskan duduk perkaranya. Alih alih ngamuk, Tristan malah senang. Ternyata Tristan lagi jenuh sama rutinitasnya dan udah lama pengen liburan. Tristan malah minta Echa dan El nyari tempat.

programme.title: Udah Paling Bener Nabrak Hati Ratu Jalanan
programme.desc: Tasya (Soraya Rasyid), seorang gadis cantik yang hobi balap motor. Pada suatu hari, Tasya dan gengnya sedang melakukan aksi balap motor liar di jalanan. Mereka nekat ngebut-ngebutan tanpa memikirkan keselamatan orang lain.Akibat geng motor tersebut, hampir saja murid Rendy (Bara Valentino) tertabrak. Sebagai guru SD, Rendy murka dan nyaris terlibat adu hantam dengan teman Tasya. Melihat ulah Rendy yang dianggapnya emosional dan tidak mencerminkan perilaku seorang guru, kepala sekolah Rendy pun memecat Rendy. Rendy semakin murka kepada Tasya dan gengnya. Ia menyalahkan anggota gang motor tersebut yang telah membuatnya kehilangan pekerjaan.

Rosi yang tak mengenali Vino pun curhat karena diselingkuhi oleh mantannya. Mungkinkah cinta mereka akan bersemi kembali?

programme.title: Mega Fights In 60 S1, Ep 1
programme.desc: MEGA Fights adalah acara-acara utama dari olahraga tinju termasuk Kejuaraan Dunia Tinju HBO dan acara-acara PPV bersejarah serta para Juara Dunia di masa lalu, saat ini, dan di masa depan. Episode kali ini menampilkan Pertarungan Terbaik Tahun 2011 versi Majalah The Ring dari Foxwoods Resort di Mashantucket, Connecticut, AS. Juara dunia kelas welter yang tak terkalahkan, Andre Berto (27-0, 21 KO) mempertaruhkan gelarnya melawan 'Vicious' Victor Ortiz (28-2, 22 KO) dalam sebuah pertarungan yang akan mengembalikan gairah Anda dalam olahraga tinju. Berto berusaha mempertahankan gelar juara dunia keenam kalinya secara beruntun, sementara Ortiz berusaha meraih gelar juara dunia pertamanya.

programme.title: Phoenix
programme.desc: Jean Grey mulai mengembangkan kekuatan luar biasa yang merusak dan mengubahnya menjadi Dark Phoenix, menyebabkan X-Men harus memutuskan apakah nyawanya lebih berharga daripada seluruh umat manusia.

programme.title: The Haunting Of Sharon Tate
programme.desc: Saat tengah mengandung anak dari sutradara Roman Polanski dan menunggu kepulangannya dari Eropa, aktris Hollywood berusia 26 tahun, Sharon Tate terusik oleh penglihatan mengenai kematiannya yang akan segera terjadi.

programme.title: Don't Suck
programme.desc: Kesempatan terakhir seorang komedian veteran untuk menjadi bintang membawanya ke jalan bersama seorang komedian muda yang mengungkap masa lalu yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Death On The Border
programme.desc: Dua wanita yang gigih berupaya melepaskan diri dari hubungan penuh kekerasan dengan seorang detektif bejat yang berada di titik terendah, bertekad untuk memindahkan gadis-gadis korban perdagangan seks melintasi perbatasan Meksiko.

programme.title: Hours
programme.desc: Seorang ayah berjuang untuk menjaga bayi perempuannya tetap hidup setelah Badai Katrina menerjang.

programme.title: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Setelah seorang jurnalis membongkar identitasnya, seorang mantan aktivis Weather Underground menjadi buron.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: Seorang petani menampung seorang pria yang terluka dengan tas berisi uang tunai. Ketika sekelompok orang datang untuk mengambil uang itu, dia harus memutuskan siapa yang bisa dipercaya. Saat mempertahankan diri dari pengepungan, dia mengungkapkan bakatnya sebagai penembak jitu yang membuat identitas aslinya dipertanyakan.

programme.title: Time Is Up
programme.desc: Vivien, yang menunda kebahagiaannya untuk masa depan, bertemu dengan Roy, seorang pemuda bermasalah. Namun, sebuah kecelakaan terjadi dan mengubah hidup keduanya. Mereka pun berfokus untuk menjadi bahagia di masa kini.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1876, seorang pemburu bayaran melacak saudaranya sendiri di seluruh Montana dengan bantuan seorang pemburu hewan ilegal.

programme.title: Holy Ghost People
programme.desc: Demi menemukan saudarinya, seorang wanita muda menyewa seorang mantan Marinir pecandu alkohol untuk membantunya menyusup ke Gereja Pantekosta One Accord.

programme.title: Kruel

programme.title: The Lurking Fear
programme.desc: Ketika kru TV merekam sebuah reality show di sebuah rumah sakit jiwa yang terbengkalai, mereka bertemu dengan gerombolan iblis, yang menyebabkan pertarungan berdarah untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: Seorang wanita Amerika memasuki area Hutan Bunuh Diri di Jepang nan legendaris untuk mencari saudari kembarnya yang menghilang secara misterius.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Saat remaja, Donny menjadi ayah seorang putra, Todd, dan membesarkannya sebagai orang tua tunggal hingga Todd berusia 18 tahun.

programme.title: Click (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Seorang arsitek yang gila kerja menemukan sebuah remote universal yang memungkinkannya untuk mempercepat dan memundurkan waktu ke berbagai bagian dalam hidupnya. Komplikasi muncul ketika remote tersebut mulai mengesampingkan pilihannya.

programme.title: Superbad (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Dua siswa SMA harus mengatasi kegelisahan mereka akan perpisahan setelah rencana mereka untuk mengadakan sebuah pesta berakhir berantakan.

programme.title: Chappie
programme.desc: Film ini menceritakan tentang sebuah robot nan dilengkapi dengan kecerdasan buatan yang dicuri oleh dua gangster lokal. Mereka ingin menggunakannya untuk sejumlah tujuan jahat.

programme.title: Ghost Rider
programme.desc: Saat pengendara sepeda motor, Johnny Blaze, melakukan perjanjian dengan iblis demi menyelamatkan sang ayah, dia pun berubah menjadi 'Ghost Rider', dan dikirim untuk memburu para pendosa.

programme.title: The Legend Of Zorro
programme.desc: Meskipun berusaha untuk menjaga agar tindakannya tidak berlebihan, ancaman terhadap status negara bagian California yang tertunda membuat Don Alejandro de la Vega yang menyukai petualangan dan istrinya, Elena, harus bertindak.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Gembong narkoba yang dipenjara menawarkan hadiah uang tunai dalam jumlah besar bagi siapa saja yang dapat membebaskannya dari tahanan polisi, dan hanya tim Senjata dan Taktik Khusus L.A.P.D. yang dapat mencegahnya.

programme.title: Monster Hunter

programme.title: The Emoji Movie

programme.title: Pokemon
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru - seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Jatuh Cinta Lagi (IMC)
programme.desc: Film ini menceritakan kisah cinta dua pengacara dengan sifat yang saling bertolak belakang. Mereka dipertemukan saat menangani kasus perceraian perebutan hak asuh anak dengan klien masing-masing.

programme.title: Lorong (IMC)
programme.desc: Setelah melahirkan, Mayang diberi tahu bahwa bayinya meninggal. Ia menolak percaya dan mencari kebenaran meski dianggap halusinasi. Semua mengira ia gila saat merasa diikuti sosok tak terlihat.

programme.title: Rumah Bekas Kuburan
programme.desc: Larasati tak sengaja terbunuh saat Karina ketahuan selingkuh dengan Danu, suaminya. Akibat peristiwa tersebut, Kirana harus memberikan tumbal untuk arwah Larasati.

programme.title: Kanan Kiri OK 2
programme.desc: Hal-hal konyol terjadi saat Tati ingin bermain dalam film setelah mengetahui Anita dan Rio, tetangganya, juga mendapat tawaran bermain dalam film.

programme.title: Hantu Budeg
programme.desc: Magda, Inge, Royce dan Bram meminta Kojek untuk mentraktir mereka liburan. Di tengah kegembiraan mereka, Magda mendapati bahwa terdapat beberapa penampakan di foto-foto yang ia ambil.

programme.title: Pelet Kuntilanak
programme.desc: Pamela yang terobsesi dengan kecantikan menggunakan ilmu gaib berupa pelet dengan celana dalam pria sebagai medianya. Ia pun harus bersekutu dengan iblis agar dapat menguasai pelet tersebut.

programme.title: Menggapai Matahari 2
programme.desc: Sekuel film Menggapai Matahari ini masih melanjutkan persaingan antara Rhoma Irama dan Beny Compo. Tak hanya ingin menghancurkan karier musik Rhoma Irama, Beny juga berniat untuk melukainya secara fisik.

programme.title: Roy Kiyoshi (The Untold Story)
programme.desc: Roy Kiyoshi, yang memiliki kemampuan berinteraksi dengan makhluk gaib, sangat terpukul ketika adik perempuannya diculik oleh iblis.

Film 13 The Haunted bercerita tentang kisah sejumlah anak muda zaman milenial, yang tak percaya dengan dunia mistis, namun penasaran ingin mengetahuinya, dan membawa mereka memasuki dunia mistis yang menegangkan dan menyeramkan

programme.title: Video Maut
programme.desc: Doni berencana mengajak kekasihnya, Maya, ke sebuah vila terpencil untuk membuat video mesum lalu menjualnya ke Alvin untuk didistribusikan di Internet. Namun, rencananya gagal ketika Maya mengajak teman-temannya.

programme.title: Kirun+Adul Pengen Punya Pacar
programme.desc: Ketika putri Wakil Presiden diculik, dua sahabat yang tinggal di Bali menjadi tersangka utama. Padahal, sang putri justru memanfaatkan mereka karena marah kepada ayahnya.

programme.title: Mudik
programme.desc: Mudik bercerita tentang Aida yang memutuskan untuk melakukan perjalanan mudik bersama sang suami, Firman ke kampung halaman mereka sekaligus untuk menemukan solusi atas konflik rumah tangga yang sedang dihadapi. Dalam perjalanan tersebut, tak sengaja mereka terlibat dalam sebuah kecelakaan yang akhirnya merenggut nyawa suami orang lain. Dalam prosesnya menghadapi kejadian yang tidak terduga ini, Aida dipaksa untuk menemukan jawaban yang selama ini tersimpan di dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Laundry Show
programme.desc: Seorang pria memilih berhenti dari pekerjaannya untuk mendirikan sebuah usaha binatu dan harus berurusan dengan berbagai kepribadian konyol para karyawannya.

programme.title: Jin & Jun (IMC)
programme.desc: Setelah dihajar para pengganggu, seorang siswa sekolah menengah yang putus asa bertemu dengan jin yang dapat membalikkan keberuntungannya - dan hartanya.

programme.title: Kuntilanak 2
programme.desc: Seorang mahasiswi memutuskan untuk pindah dari rumah kos lamanya nan angker guna melarikan diri dari para pengikut aliran Sekte Mangkoedjiwo yang ingin membalas dendam atas kematian Sri Sukmarahimi Mangkoedjiwo.

programme.title: Kabut Sutra Ungu
programme.desc: Menggambarkan penderitaan dan ketabahan seorang janda bernama Miranti yang berusaha keras untuk hidup mandiri di tengah masalah dalam menghadapi kakak iparnya, Dimas, yang jatuh cinta padanya.

programme.title: Kawin Kontrak 3
programme.desc: Gerry menggantikan Kang Sono sebagai makelar kawin kontrak. Ceppy, Itol, dan Dani akhirnya menikah dengan wanita idaman mereka dan memulai hidup baru mereka yang unik.

programme.desc: Madun

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

Setiap blok angka memiliki nilai numeriknya sendiri dan memiliki kepribadian yang unik. mereka bergabung dan berinteraksi satu sama lain untuk memecahkan masalah matematika sambil mengajarkan konsep dasar matematika seperti penjumlahan, pengurangan, perkalian, pembagian, dan konsep lainnya. Setiap episode dari "numberblocks" biasanya menampilkan cerita pendek di mana blok angka bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas atau menghadapi tantangan matematika. programme.title: PythagoraSwitch

programme.title: Peek-A-Boo

Setiap episode berdurasi 15 menit dan menampilkan berbagai karakter lucu, seperti anjing berbulu putih dan boneka berwarna cerah, yang dirancang untuk menarik perhatian dan merangsang perkembangan sensorik anak.

programme.title: With Mother

programme.title: 1-Minute Anime: Songs For SDGs

Program ini bertujuan untuk mendidik generasi muda mengenai pentingnya keberlanjutan dan tanggung jawab sosial secara kreatif dan menyenangka/

programme.desc: Acara ini menampilkan kabar seputar kehidupan selebriti, mulai dari aktivitas, prestasi, hingga gosip terkini yang sedang menjadi sorotan publik.

programme.title: New Taiwan Online
programme.desc: New Taiwan Online merupakan program diskusi berita dari Sanlih News yang menghadirkan ulasan mendalam mengenai berbagai isu terkini di Taiwan maupun dunia. Dipandu oleh Hsu Kuei-ya, acara ini mengangkat topik politik, ekonomi, hubungan internasional, hingga isu sosial yang sedang menjadi perhatian publik. Melalui diskusi bersama jurnalis, pengamat, akademisi, dan narasumber terkait, program ini menyajikan analisis yang komprehensif dan beragam sudut pandang untuk membantu pemirsa memahami perkembangan peristiwa secara lebih mendalam.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: Blessing Of Formosa
programme.desc: Blessing of Formosa merupakan program budaya dan perjalanan yang memperkenalkan keindahan tradisi rakyat Taiwan. Setiap episode mengunjungi kuil-kuil bersejarah, perayaan keagamaan, dan komunitas lokal untuk mengungkap kisah para dewa, adat istiadat, kerajinan tradisional, hingga kuliner khas daerah. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan menghibur, acara ini tidak hanya memperkenalkan destinasi wisata, tetapi juga melestarikan nilai-nilai budaya serta warisan spiritual yang menjadi bagian penting dari identitas masyarakat Taiwan.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night merupakan salah satu acara variety paling populer di Taiwan. Dipandu oleh Jacky Wu bersama Chen Han-Dian dan Lulu Huang, setiap episode menghadirkan bintang tamu dari dunia hiburan untuk mengikuti berbagai permainan kreatif, tantangan bertema, penampilan musik, hingga segmen komedi yang mengundang tawa. Dengan perpaduan hiburan, kompetisi, dan interaksi spontan antar selebritas, acara ini telah menjadi favorit pemirsa serta meraih berbagai penghargaan bergengsi, termasuk Golden Bell Awards.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Piala Presiden 2026
programme.desc: Turnamen pramusim paling bergengsi: PIALA PRESIDEN 2026! Segera digelar di dua stadion internasional, Stadion Si Jalak Harupat, Bandung, dan Stadion Gelora Bung Tomo, Surabaya, 25 Juli - 6 Agustus 2026. Memasuki edisi ke-8, PIALA PRESIDEN 2026 akan diikuti 8 klub dari 4 negara: Indonesia oleh Persib Bandung, Persebaya Surabaya, Persija Jakarta, Arema FC, dan PSMS Medan; Singapura oleh Tampines Rovers FC; Brunei Darussalam oleh DPMM FC; Tailan oleh Port FC, juara bertahan PIALA PRESIDEN 2025. Seluruh peserta siap berlaga dalam dua grup dengan total 16 pertandingan untuk memperebutkan gelar juara PIALA PRESIDEN 2026. Saksikan pertandingan Piala Presiden 2026 di SIN PO tv!

programme.desc: Bikin Laper merupakan program wisata kuliner sekaligus mengulas berbagai jenis makanan dan masakan Indonesia maupun mancanegara. Aneka kuliner nusantara seperti tak ada habisnya. Semakin kaya rasa dan kaya variasi. Host yang seru dan ekpresif menambah pemirsa penasaran dengan sajian kuliner yang disantap.

programme.title: Insert Story
programme.desc: Talkshow infotaiment menghadirkan para selebritis langsung ke studio untuk membeberkan kisahnya. Semakin seru dengan hadirnya para ahli untuk membantu menemukan berbagai solusi yang tepat bagi semua.

programme.title: Une Brique Dans Le Ventre
programme.desc: In addition to the houses, apartments and lofts of various styles and prices which Cedric Wautier shows us through his many visits, this programme about homes offers legal, practical, technical, energy and aesthetic advice, without forgetting the part about the all-important DIY ''tricks''.

programme.title: UNE BRIQUE DANS LE VENTRE
programme.desc: Une Brique dans le Ventre menampilkan proyek renovasi rumah, ide desain interior, dan inspirasi arsitektur bersama para ahli.

programme.title: Fleuve En Eaux Troubles
programme.desc: Noise pollution disrupts communication between belugas and their calves. The MARS project analyzes underwater sounds to propose solutions and protect this fragile ecosystem.

programme.title: FLEUVE EN EAUX TROUBLES
programme.desc: FLEUVE EN EAUX TROUBLES — Menyelami persoalan lingkungan, kisah tersembunyi, dan hubungan antara manusia dengan alam di sekitar sungai yang menghadapi berbagai tantangan serius.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Four little dinosaurs, Rocky, Bill, Tiny and Mazu, discover a dangerous world where the mysterious Gigantosaurus, the most ferocious of all the dinosaurs, is forever on the prowl. The four best friends set their heading for adventure, confronting their fears and working together to solve all their problems.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Rocky, Bill, Tiny dan Mazu adalah empat dinosaurus muda yang tumbuh pada periode Cretaceous. Mereka sekawanan dinosaurus yang selalu mencari petualangan baru di setiap tempat yang mereka kunjungi. Gunung berapi baru bermunculan setiap saat, brachiosaurus berleher panjang dan triceratops raksasa berkeliaran bebas, hujan meteor menerangi langit malam dan Gigantosaurus yang ganas menguasai semuanya. Bisakah mereka berteman dengan Giganto, sang Raja Dinosaurus.

programme.title: L'Afrik En Contes
programme.desc: A woman has four children. The youngest was born just as her husband died; convinced the baby is a bringer of bad luck she refuses to feed him. One day, the hyena Bouki becomes interested in this unwanted child.

programme.title: L'AFRIK EN CONTES
programme.desc: L'AFRIK EN CONTES menghidupkan kembali dongeng tradisional Afrika melalui animasi penuh warna dan penceritaan yang menarik. Setiap episode menyampaikan pesan moral, humor, dan warisan budaya, memperkenalkan penonton muda pada tokoh-tokoh legendaris serta kebijaksanaan turun-temurun.

programme.title: Defense De Nourrir Les Animaux
programme.desc: Surprising foray into the animal kingdom. Infused with humor, these short capsules highlight the distinctive traits of certain species. Scientific facts that are often little-known and almost always bewildering!

programme.title: DÉFENSE DE NOURRIR LES ANIMAUX
programme.desc: DÉFENSE DE NOURRIR LES ANIMAUX mengulas bagaimana interaksi manusia memengaruhi perilaku satwa liar, keseimbangan ekosistem, dan upaya konservasi, sekaligus mengajak masyarakat hidup berdampingan secara bertanggung jawab dengan alam.

programme.title: Defense De Nourrir Les Animaux
programme.desc: Surprising foray into the animal kingdom. Infused with humor, these short capsules highlight the distinctive traits of certain species. Scientific facts that are often little-known and almost always bewildering!

programme.title: DÉFENSE DE NOURRIR LES ANIMAUX
programme.desc: DÉFENSE DE NOURRIR LES ANIMAUX mengulas bagaimana interaksi manusia memengaruhi perilaku satwa liar, keseimbangan ekosistem, dan upaya konservasi, sekaligus mengajak masyarakat hidup berdampingan secara bertanggung jawab dengan alam.

programme.title: 1001 Mondes Antiques
programme.desc: Braillard, Colombe and Lablatte have discovered a way of travelling back through ancient eras and civilisations. They embark on a journey back in time, passing through popular civilisations such as ancient Egypt and Greece, as well as sub-Saharan Africa, the Middle East and Mesopotamia.

programme.title: 1001 MONDES ANTIQUES
programme.desc: 1001 MONDES ANTIQUES mengajak penonton menelusuri berbagai peradaban kuno melalui penemuan arkeologi, monumen bersejarah, dan kisah yang membentuk sejarah umat manusia.

programme.title: Conte-Nous !
programme.desc: A long, long time ago, in the heart of the African savannah, animals still had the gift of speech. It was also a time of story-telling, of tales that had so much to teach us, where the main character was a lion, a hyena, a leopard or a frog.

programme.title: Quasimodo
programme.desc: Paris, 1483. 16-year-old Quasimodo is a hunchbacked orphan. One day, the gypsy Esmeralda, with whom he is in love, finds herself in trouble. He sacrifices himself to save her and ends up in prison. And so begins a long series of adventures...

programme.title: Tout Le Monde Veut Prendre Sa Place
programme.desc: The game where everyone wants to be a winner. One quiz, six candidates and, comfortably installed in his chair, one champion... whom everyone dreams of unseating!

programme.title: TOUT LE MONDE VEUT PRENDRE SA PLACE
programme.desc: Tout le Monde Veut Prendre sa Place adalah kuis populer di mana peserta menantang juara bertahan untuk merebut posisi teratas.

programme.title: Demo De Mode
programme.desc: Inspired by faraway countries for the setting for his autumn-winter 2024-2025 haute couture collection, the designer Stephane Rolland pays tribute to Paris.

programme.title: DÉMO DE MODE
programme.desc: DÉMO DE MODE mengeksplorasi dunia mode modern melalui peragaan busana, wawancara desainer, dan liputan di balik layar yang menampilkan kreativitas industri fesyen.

programme.title: Un Si Grand Soleil
programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Levy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. Between romance and crime thriller, with a blend of comic and serious themes, their stories weave a fascinating web.

programme.title: Les Heros Du Patrimoine
programme.desc: An abandoned industrial site exists in the heart of Roubaix: a former cotton mill that once contributed to the city's glory. This is the somewhat surprising spot Adrien Gavazzi has chosen as his starting point. The Hauts-de-France region is home to 50% of France's industrial wastelands.

programme.title: LES HÉROS DU PATRIMOINE
programme.desc: LES HÉROS DU PATRIMOINE menampilkan sejarawan, arsitek, pengrajin, dan relawan yang berdedikasi merawat bangunan bersejarah serta melestarikan warisan budaya Prancis.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: La (Tres) Grande Evasion

programme.title: Undercover Chef: Korea, Ep 10
programme.desc: Koki Kwon Sung Jun, Jung Ji Sun, dan Sam Kim telah dikenal luas di dunia kuliner Korea Selatan. Meski kini berstatus sebagai koki ternama, sudah lama sejak mereka terakhir bekerja sebagai juru masak junior di dapur. Untuk membuktikan bahwa kemampuan mereka masih tajam, ketiganya dikirim ke negara-negara yang menginspirasi masakan mereka dan menyamar sebagai staf dapur tingkat bawah. Tantangannya tidak berhenti di situ: mereka hanya memiliki lima hari untuk mengesankan atasan mereka dan membuat hidangan khas yang berhasil masuk ke menu restoran. Akankah pengalaman dan keterampilan mereka cukup untuk meraih kesuksesan atau justru mereka akan tumbang di bawah tekanan?

Pindol adalah teknisi pengeboran terbaik di negeri ini. Mereka membentuk tim dengan Jeobsae, Kepala Bagian Na, Keunsab dan Counter untuk menyelesaikan pencurian yang mustahil. Ketika tugas tertunda karena berbagai kemunduran, risikonya berlipat ganda.

programme.title: The Black Cat
programme.desc: While looking through his telescope one night, John Putnam (Richard Carlson) sees what at first appears to be a meteor shower -- but it is actually a crash-landing alien spaceship! After investigating the crater from the impact, John informs the town sheriff (Charles Drake), and receives nothing but ridicule. Even his fiancée, Ellen (Barbara Rush), is skeptical. All that changes when the townsfolk start disappearing, and are replaced by eerie alien duplicates.

programme.title: Thrill Seekers
programme.desc: When intrepid reporter Tom Merrick discovers that the same man appears in photographs of major disasters over a hundred-year period, he embarks on an incredible action-filled race against time to prevent a series of new disasters.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergrass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Break Point [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A rough around the edges tennis pro is making one final crack at a major doubles tournament. Due to his drinking and on court attitude, other pros shy away from being his partner. He'll have to ask his younger brother for help if he wants to succeed.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: Limitless
programme.desc: Facing unemployment and his girlfriend's rejection, writer Eddie Morra is sure that he has no future. That all changes when an old friend gives him a drug that produces enhanced mental acuity. Stoked on the untested chemical, Eddie rises to the top of the financial world and attracts the attention of a tycoon who intends to use him to make a fortune. But terrible side effects and a dwindling supply threaten to collapse Eddie's house of cards.

programme.title: Arlington Road [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Gerry [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po's present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow. All the Teletubbies laugh as they play in the snow.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see some children visit a level crossing and watch a train pass by. The Teletubbies play their Ready, Steady, Go game.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play a slide game before watching Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm. Then their mum cooks them for their tea. In Teletubbyland, the Lion and Bear play their hide and seek game.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep. Laa-Laa wants to sing a lovely song, but Tinky Winky is crunching his Tubby Toast too loudly!

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies march up and down a hill and then they watch some children explore the colour pink. Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Laa-Laa dances with her ball. A little boy tells us why he likes to live in his block of flats. A balloon appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies follow a balloon.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies giggle as they play their 'Through the Arch' game. The windmill stops them to watch a little girl and her dad go for a walk in the town.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Naughty Pig. Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa run into Home Hill to say 'Eh-oh', but where 's Po? Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing 'Handy Hands'.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes. In Teletubbyland, something happens to Dipsy's hat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast. They play the game 'Two Little Teletubbies', but while they are playing the Noo-Noo tidies up their Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.

programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. Holed up in a North Carolina truck stop, a group of survivors must fend for themselves against a mass of homicidal trucks. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

programme.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
programme.desc: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

programme.title: Sharknado
programme.desc: A monstrous storm devastates Los Angeles, leaving the streets flooded and infested with sharks.

programme.title: Sharknado 2: The Second One
programme.desc: A freak weather system turns its deadly fury on New York City, unleashing a Sharknado on the population and its most cherished, iconic sites - and only Fin and April can save the Big Apple.

programme.title: Flight 7500
programme.desc: A supernatural force terrorizes airline passengers.

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

programme.title: Married to the Mob
programme.desc: Angela de Marco (Michelle Pfeiffer) is fed up with her gangster husband's (Alec Baldwin) line of work and wants no part of the crime world. When her husband is killed for having an affair with the mistress of mob boss Tony "The Tiger" Russo (Dean Stockwell), Angela and her son depart for New York City to make a fresh start. Unfortunately, Tony has set his sights upon Angela -- and so has an undercover FBI agent (Matthew Modine) looking to use her to bust Tony.

programme.title: When a Stranger Calls
programme.desc: A retired police detective hunts a deranged British seaman out to re-create a babysitter's horror.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. Holed up in a North Carolina truck stop, a group of survivors must fend for themselves against a mass of homicidal trucks. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

programme.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
programme.desc: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

programme.title: Troll 2
programme.desc: When young Joshua (Michael Stephenson) learns that he will be going on vacation with his family to a small town called Nilbog, he protests adamantly. He is warned by the spirit of his deceased grandfather that goblins populate the town. His parents, Michael (George Hardy) and Diana (Margo Prey), dismiss his apprehensions, but soon learn to appreciate their son's warnings. Guided by his grandfather's ghost, will Joshua and his family stand a chance in fighting off these evil beings?

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

programme.title: Bug
programme.desc: At a rundown desert motel, Agnes (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer named Peter (Michael Shannon). He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair.

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

programme.title: Evil Under the Sun
programme.desc: Agatha Christie's Belgian sleuth, Hercule Poirot (Peter Ustinov), solves the murder of an actress at a Balkan resort.

programme.title: Chick Fight
programme.desc: When Anna joins an all-female, underground fight club to turn her mess of a life around, she soon discovers she's much more personally connected to the history of the club than she ever could have imagined.

After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

programme.title: Tank Girl

Unwilling to cower under Kesslee's tyrannical rule, a pair of outlaws known as Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and Jet Girl (Naomi Watts) rise up, joining the mysterious rebel Rippers to destroy the corrupt system.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy

programme.title: Boulevard! A Hollywood Story
programme.desc: Dickson Hughes and Richard Stapley, two young songwriters and romantic partners, find themselves caught in movie star Gloria Swanson's web when she hires them to write a musical version of "Sunset Boulevard."

programme.title: The Reality of Truth
programme.desc: Michelle Rodriguez joins a search for a Hidden Technology from our Ancient past that has been locked away for thousands of years and in the process, uncovers a connection between religion, psychedelics, and a mysterious spirit culture.

programme.title: Get Close
programme.desc: Tony Turner loses his father while in prison due to health issues. When he leaves prison, he meets a young lady named Kimaya, who he begins to fall in love with but refuses to allow her in, all while ducking the guy whose drugs he went to prison for.

programme.title: Love Meet Hope
programme.desc: A grandfather's love stories enlighten a jaded man and a moonstruck girl about the realities of love.

programme.title: Emotions of a Murder
programme.desc: This film takes a cinematic perspective to show you how violence impacts more than just the victim.

programme.title: Dalton Trumbo's: Johnny Got His Gun
programme.desc: Go inside the mind of a soldier, trapped in a severely wounded body, as he struggles to separate his thoughts & memories from the world around him. Filmed in the style of Lars von Trier's Dogville, Ben McKenzie "gives a bravura thespian workout"-Variety.

programme.title: Rolling Kansas
programme.desc: The Murphy boys, whose hippie parents were sent to prison when they were young, have grown into problematic adults. Dick (James Roday), for example, is a divorced and struggling salesman, and Dave (Jay Paulson) works at a gas station. Luckily, the Murphys' parents left them a map to a secret government marijuana field -- so Dick, Dave and their paraplegic brother, Dinkadoo (Sam Huntington), along with two friends, set off to find this legendary pot, which they hope to sell.

programme.title: Road Games
programme.desc: An Australian trucker (Stacy Keach) picks up a hitchhiking heiress (Jamie Lee Curtis) and the trail of a killer in a green van.

programme.title: Two Thousand and None
programme.desc: A man finds himself seeing life from a new point when he finds out it's almost over. Before long he starts seeing images of his childhood in Armenia everywhere. His last mission in life is to dig up his parents in Canada and bury them in Armenia, where he believes him and his family belong.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: After Regina Lampert (Audrey Hepburn) falls for the dashing Peter Joshua (Cary Grant) on a skiing holiday in the French Alps, she discovers upon her return to Paris that her husband has been murdered. Soon, she and Peter are giving chase to three of her late husband's World War II cronies, Tex (James Coburn), Scobie (George Kennedy) and Gideon (Ned Glass), who are after a quarter of a million dollars the quartet stole while behind enemy lines. But why does Peter keep changing his name?

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Chinese martial arts student Chen Zhen is studying in Kyoto, Japan, when he learns his mentor has died in a match against Ryuichi Akutagawa. Returning home to the Japanese-occupied Shanghai of 1937, Chen challenges Ryuichi to a fight and easily defeats him. Concluding his master was set up, Chen has an autopsy performed. Meanwhile, word of his martial arts skill entices new students hoping to study with him, making his teacher's son, Huo Ting-An, jealous.

programme.title: Studio 666
programme.desc: Members of the rock band Foo Fighters move into an Encino mansion steeped in grisly rock 'n' roll history to record their much anticipated 10th album. Once in the house, Dave Grohl finds himself grappling with supernatural forces that threaten both the completion of the album and the lives of the band members.

programme.title: Fifty Shades of Black
programme.desc: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," Hannah Steele interviews entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) for her roommate's school newspaper. The wealthy and eligible Black quickly learns how clumsy the young woman is. As flirtation leads to attraction, Christian invites Hannah to his home and introduces her to his kinky world of S&M. Despite their different backgrounds, the new couple consistently surprise each other with how far they're willing to go to make their relationship work.

programme.title: Bright Young Things
programme.desc: During the 1930s in England, a group of young socialites dominate the national gossip with extravagant and outlandish antics. Among the group is the aspiring novelist Adam Fenwick-Symes, who is attempting to raise enough money to marry fellow member Nina Blount. However, after customs officials confiscate his first manuscript, Fenwick-Symes must recover from the financial setback and figure out new ways to earn money for a wedding.

programme.title: Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas
programme.desc: Emmet and Ma Otter are very poor, but they are very happy and talented singers. Christmas is around the corner, and they both want to get the other a very special present. The prize in the talent show is $50. Both Emmet and Ma get a song ready for the competition; Emmet forms a jug band, and Ma practices alone, to vie with the Riverbottom Gang.

programme.title: Filly Brown
programme.desc: Majo Tonorio (Gina Rodriguez), a talented hip-hop artist, is offered a record deal from a sleazy producer. She faces a difficult choice between selling out for money or staying true to herself and her music.

programme.title: The Air I Breathe
programme.desc: Four stories are linked by a Chinese proverb and overlapping characters. A usually unadventurous man (Forest Whitaker) loses big on a horse race and robs a bank to pay off a gangster (Andy Garcia). The gangster's nephew goes on the town with a hit man (Brendan Fraser) who can see into the future. The hit man falls for a pop star (Sarah Michelle Gellar) whose contract is owned by the gangster. The pop star has a rare blood type sought by a doctor (Kevin Bacon) trying to save the love of his life.

programme.title: Rough Magic
programme.desc: In the midst of a dazzling stage show, magician's assistant Myra Shumway (Bridget Fonda) catches the eye of sleazy industrialist Cliff Wyatt (D.W. Moffett). When Wyatt unwittingly kills Shumway's mentor, a master magician, she flees to Mexico. Furious, Wyatt hires private detective Alex Ross (Russell Crowe) to capture the gorgeous witness to his crime. But, after Ross locates Shumway, he finds himself beguiled by her growing prowess as a magician -- and by the potency of her feminine charms.

programme.desc: A woman embarks on a vengeful quest to save her kidnapped daughter from a mysterious man from her past.

programme.desc: A Los Angeles kickboxer (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) trains with a master (Joe Marie Avellana) in Manila to avenge his brother in a tournament.

programme.title: Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: Jesus' teachings draw large crowds.

programme.title: Blind Dating
programme.desc: Danny (Chris Pine) is a blind man who does not let his impairment get in the way of living his life to the fullest, except when it comes to love. Danny's brother (Eddie Kaye Thomas) sets him up on a series of blind dates, but all of them go disastrously wrong. Just when Danny is about to give up, he meets Leeza (Anjali Jay), a nurse who works for Danny's doctor. There is just one catch: Leeza, who is from India, is promised to another man.

programme.title: Welcome Home, Roxy Carmichael

And now the whole town of Clyde is bracing for Carmichael's return, most of all her now-married old flame Denton Webb and troubled teen Dinky Bossetti. An orphan with few friends, Dinky is convinced that Carmichael is her birth mother, and that the actress will reclaim her when she returns.

programme.title: The TV Set
programme.desc: Mike Klein (David Duchovny), the creator of a TV pilot called "The Wexler Chronicles," learns the hard way about how television shows evolve from concept to reality. Though Mike's concept involves serious subject, a network executive (Sigourney Weaver) and her cohorts have other plans to lighten up and dumb down the show to appeal to a broader audience.

programme.title: Big Fan

He lives at home with his mother and spends much of his free time extolling the virtues of his favorite football team on sports radio. One night, Paul and his best friend, Sal, spy Giants linebacker Quantrell Bishop in their neighborhood and follow him to a strip club. Paul decides to approach his idol, but the encounter goes very badly.

programme.title: Before I Go to Sleep

In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Brotherhood Of The Wolf [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story

Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child.
